observations: Summary counters match the final register: seven drawings, 15 image files, zero added full-body bases, 112 total bases, 97 catalogue IDs and 96 production identities still without a full base, 121 gallery entries, 46 stages, 43 fighters and 24 costume families.
The three new portraits are explicit partial narrative archives. Molly retains the 2015 legacy design; no full-body gap is closed by these portraits.
The Sloth consultation room is distinct from the existing waiting room and exterior. Its separate container is a scenery prop; the two different Oops trophies remain gallery props.
The refused correction of the small Stolas family butler is shown as a separate, undelivered candidate; it is not merged with the accepted tall Mister Butler portrait.

Source resolution, narrow artwork margins, native alpha behavior and static-only limits remain visible. Independent image-review notes keep their original review scope; later browser checks are summarized separately.
limitations: No native Excel application was opened. Artifact Tool recalculation, changed-input restoration, reimport and OOXML inspection were run.
Rendered previews are reproducible internal QA artifacts kept in /tmp, not separate delivered artwork.
The linked browser evidence is local Chromium at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile touch emulation 390x844, not a physical device, cross-browser pass or deployed-build browser check.
The stage preserves its full aspect ratio, with solid side margins on desktop and an upper solid-color band in the tall mobile arena; no crop or stretch is claimed.
The inherited S1/S2 selector filters gallery, roster and costumes. Arena availability uses a separate S3 gate; S2 arenas are not hidden by the S1 gallery selector.
Reference link text and href values were checked locally; the browser pass did not open external destination pages.
